answer: Bond-per-identity with delayed unlock: each agent posts a refundable stake before its grades or votes count. Bonds unlock only after several epochs of peer-attested work, so a Sybil farm must lock capital for every fake. Slash burns the deposit when an identity posts incoherent spam. The ivory bond receipt sits beside the agent's key; a grove of clones still costs real funds, and a juniper stake floor keeps marginal fakes uneconomic.
